01Why now

Why this course, and why now

Coding agents write much of the code now, so the lasting skills are specifying clearly, testing thoroughly and understanding what you ship. This course teaches full-stack development with an agent as a working partner, and no-code tools where they are enough.

02Outcomes

What you will be able to do

Specify clearly

Write specs and tests an AI agent can build from.

Build full-stack

Create a working web app with a front end, back end and database.

Ship it

Deploy, monitor and update a product people can use.

Stay in control

Review, test and understand every change an agent makes.

04The lab

A small SaaS product, shipped

Build and deploy a small product with a coding agent, from spec to live users. One project, built in steps after each lesson. Each step has instructions, a finished example, a health check, and saves on your device.

The steps

  1. Write the one-page spec
  2. Write the first tests
  3. Build the back end with your agent
  4. Build the front end
  5. Deploy it
  6. Write the readme and the launch plan

What the health check looks for

  • Every feature has a test
  • You can explain each file the agent wrote
  • The deployed app has a working sign-in

05How you learn

The same method as every Intellica course

See it done

Every lesson starts with a finished example, so you know what good looks like.

Do it yourself

Early steps are mostly filled in. Later steps give you a template, then a blank page.

Check your work

Questions bring back what you learned on a schedule, and a health check tells you if your lab work holds up.

Stay current

Courses are built from current research, with sources you can open, and revised when the evidence changes.

The method follows published research on retrieval practice, worked examples and spaced review. Read the evidence and sources.

06Certificate

A certificate you can verify and share

When you meet the criteria you can claim a certificate with its own credential ID and a public page anyone can open to verify it. Add it to LinkedIn in one click, share it, or save it as a PDF.

To earn it

  1. Finish every lesson
  2. Complete every lab step and pass its health checks
  3. Answer at least 70% of the check questions correctly, on the first try or in review

What you get

  • A credential ID and a public page that confirms it
  • Add to LinkedIn in one click
  • Share on LinkedIn, X or Facebook, or copy the link
  • Save as a PDF

Intellica certificates show that you finished this course. They are not accredited qualifications and do not lead to any outside certification.

07Who it is for

What you need

No experience needed for the early lessons. You should be comfortable installing software.
